The '''Smuggled Sithspawn''' was a [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] who had been smuggled onto [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shadaa]] and who was able to be won by attendees to either the [[Star Cluster Casino]] or [[Club Vertica Casino]].<ref name="event">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=event|Nar Shaddaa Nightlife}}</ref>
